summary: Fixed all nine S5 review findings; VM clippy, 230 tests and Wasm checks pass.
body:
Changed this round:

- `crates/interchange/src/lib.rs`
- `crates/interchange/src/scene/import.rs`
- `crates/interchange/src/scene/import/properties.rs`
- `crates/interchange/src/scene/import/overlay.rs`
- `crates/interchange/src/scene/import/tests.rs`

The existing uncommitted implementation and `scene/mod.rs` reexports are preserved. No commits or dependencies were added.

Public API remains:

```rust
pub fn scene::import(
    bytes: &[u8],
    opts: &ImportOptions,
) -> Result<(Imported, Vec<Overlay>, Report)>;

pub struct Overlay {
    pub item: ItemId,
    pub path: String,
    pub document: Vec<u8>,
}

pub fn import_with(
    bytes: &[u8],
    format: Format,
    opts: &ImportOptions,
) -> Result<(Imported, Report)>;
```

`ImportOptions.lenient` still defaults to false. Scene dispatch now precedes allocating text decoding.

Design notes:

- Keys now use checked media-clock arithmetic matching `TrackItem::effect_time_at` and `moving_source_time_at` in `crates/project/src/lib.rs`. Mapping includes source in-point, speed, reverse and each loop segment. Reverse hold interpolation preserves its discontinuity.
- Holds use `frame_hold`, `hold_filters = false` and speed 1 for the moving effect clock. XSD `layerType@speed` and `@freezeAt` freeze the source frame; animation remains on the timeline defined by `animateType@timeBase`.
- Snapped video source positions include the signed-rate adjustment from the raw start. Linked audio retains its original edges.
- Unknown media durations use checked source-out and held-frame bounds. The moving hold clock is checked too, preventing overflow from escaping into rendering.
- Complete overlay sequences retain their sequence semantics and transitions. Only pruned wrappers become groups with resolved child placement; animation children retain their original timing. This follows XSD `sequenceType`.
- Font closure includes families named by `font` and `fallback`, including references reached through inherited text styles. Family lookup is indexed and repeated expansion is bounded. Sources: XSD `characterStyle`, `fontAssetType`, `textStyleType`, and pinned-font rules C72/C73.
- Volume remains a dB parameter, but amplitude curves are sampled before conversion. Sampling uses at most 4,096 intervals per segment, with absolute amplitude error below 0.001 for the mapped curves. The approximation is reported, and generated samples and emitted keys have 100,000-key caps. Permanent gain silence applies only to mute. FilmCraft’s dB parameter is defined in `crates/project/src/effect.rs`.

Overlay file-reference audit covered: `src`, `proxy`, `fontFile`, `cache`, `baseColorMap`, `normalMap`, `metallicRoughnessMap`, `occlusionMap`, `emissiveMap`, `displacementMap`, `materialX`, `weights`, `shader`, `ies`, `environment`, `ocioConfig`, `path`, `uri`, `report`, `mapStyle`, and file-valued caption `model`.

Classification uses XSD types plus the string-valued exceptions: image-sequence patterns, basemap styles and caption models. SVG geometry paths, texture `#id` references, non-file URIs and built-in basemap names remain intact. Windows paths retain common importer behavior.

Caption-model ambiguity: the reference renderer distinguishes model names from files using filesystem checks (`scene-render/crates/sr-resolve/src/providers/whisper.rs::model_file`). This pure importer rebases explicit paths and `.bin` filenames and preserves bare provider names. Use an explicit path such as `./model` for an extensionless model file.

No external code was borrowed. The Whisper source was consulted for semantics only; no attribution addition is required.

Observed TDD red → green log; names below share prefix `scene_import_review_`:

| Item | Regression and observed red result | Green result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `1_dispatch_before_text_allocation`: dispatch-order assertion failed. Includes oversized non-UTF-8 input checks in both modes. | Pass |
| 2 | `2_media_clock_trim_speed_reverse_and_loops`, `2_hold_animates_effects`: initial opacity was 100 instead of 0. | Pass for trims, speed, reverse, loops and holds; outgoing reverse-hold regression also passes |
| 3 | `3_snapped_video_keeps_audio_source_phase`: video source differed from the hand-calculated value by more than one tick. | Pass forward and reverse |
| 4 | `4_complete_symbol_sequence_stays_intact`: sequence became a group. Supplemental pruned-animation test returned a missing-placement error. | Both pass; overlay validation passes |
| 5 | `5_unknown_media_duration_from_source_uses`: duration was zero instead of 7 seconds; supplemental hold check returned 3 seconds + 1 tick instead of 5 seconds. `5_hold_moving_clock_overflow_is_rejected` incorrectly accepted overflow. | Both pass |
| 6 | `6_overlay_font_family_closure`: generated overlay failed C72/C73. | Direct and inherited-style cases pass |
| 7 | `7_overlay_font_file_relocated`: retained `fonts/test.ttf` instead of `../fonts/test.ttf`. Supplemental tests exposed altered ocio URIs/SVG paths and unrevised image patterns, map styles and model files. | All six relocation regressions pass, including Windows paths and overlay validation |
| 8 | `8_zero_volume_can_animate_to_audible`: final amplitude was not 1. | Pass |
| 9 | `9_volume_fade_is_amplitude_linear`: midpoint was not 0.5. | Pass, including 4,001 amplitude samples within tolerance |

Font fixtures were corrected for required schema fields before their meaningful red runs. The Windows expected path was corrected to match common::resolve_path’s separator convention; implementation behavior was preserved.

Final required gate ran exclusively through `vm-agent.sh import`, with incremental compilation and debug information disabled through environment overrides:

- Clippy, all targets, `-D warnings`: passed.
- Tests: **171 unit + 59 integration = 230 passed**, including 18 new regressions.
- `cargo xtask wasm`: **50 crates passed**.
- Local `git diff --check`: passed.

The engine must still write returned overlay documents before merging the imported fragment. No out-of-scope changes are required. Coordination task completed and all five locks released.
